regulations.title: Maharashtra Directorate of Industrial Safety & Health (DISH) — Notification No. DISH/2025/CR-88
regulations.shortTitle: Industrial Safety Standards Revision: Automated Fire Suppression Protocols
regulations.authority: Maharashtra Directorate of Industrial Safety & Health (DISH)
regulations.summary: Statutory amendment to the Maharashtra Factories Rules regarding mandatory automated digital telemetry logging for hazardous process machinery, calibration telemetry chains, and direct API push to the DISH Central Cloud.
regulations.impactQuote: Manufacture with additional fire safety mitigation: complete sensor retrofitting and register the compliance certificate on the DISH portal.
regulations.beforeChange: Manual physical inspection logs filed on an accredited third-party mechanical inspector. Manual physical signatures on Form-8 logbooks stored in plant records. Calibration and pressure testing conducted during planned shutdown (12-month cycles).
regulations.nowChange: Mandatory continuous or quarterly digital telemetry reporting with geotagged, cryptographically signed equipment calibration certificates. Real-time heat transmission monitoring via ultrasonic BLE mesh gateway with 30-minute maximum manual polling interval.

aiResponse.question: “Does the latest DISH Maharashtra notification on fire safety require us to replace our existing manual fire alarm systems before November?”
aiResponse.executiveSynthesis: No, you do not need to replace manual pull stations. However, you are required to install automated optical smoke/heat sensor telemetry in all enclosed fabrication bays with more than 15 workers, and integrate them with an off-site alert repeater by 30 October 2025.

citations.authority: Maharashtra Directorate of Industrial Safety & Health (DISH)
citations.excerpt: “Every manufacturing occupancy classified under Section 2(m)(ii) maintaining more than fifteen operatives within unpartitioned worksheds shall, in addition to standard manual apparatus, ensure contiguous wireless or looped heat/optical telemetry coupled to a certified auxiliary alerting repeater.”
